relationships.subject: Sida cordifolia extract
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with SCE and SAF suppressed oxido-inflammatory cascade along with attenuation of KIF-17 mediated NR2B trafficking and neuroinflammation in DRG and spinal tissues of neuropathic rats.

relationships.subject: Sida cordifolia extract
relationships.evidence_quote: Both the whole extract (SCE) and the aqueous fraction (SAF) demonstrate a significant reduction in mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity by inhibiting KIF-17 mediated NR2B signaling in nerve injured rats

relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: neuropeptides (CGRP and Substance P), KIF-17 and NR2B expressions were found to be significantly upregulated in DRG and spinal cord of nerve injured rats

key_findings: Sida cordifolia extract reduces CCI-induced hypersensitivity in rats, attenuating KIF-17-mediated NR2B signaling and CGRP upregulation.
